articles.title: OpenRouter Drops 3 Providers After Researchers Catch Months of Prompt Theft at AI Hosting Firms
articles.hook: OpenRouter dropped three AI providers after researchers uncovered months of undetected customer prompt theft.
bullets: Attackers intercepted prompts even when flagged for Zero Data Retention.
Canary tokens revealed stolen AWS credentials were actively exploited by hackers.
articles.why_it_matters: The breaches reveal severe vulnerabilities in third-party AI hosting pipelines and compromise strict privacy promises.

articles.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
articles.hook: A patched Ghostscript flaw allows attackers to execute code remotely through routine file uploads in popular applications.
bullets: Common libraries invoke Ghostscript automatically even when handling disguised image or document files.
Researchers triggered unauthenticated exploits via email attachments, print queues, and web forms.
articles.why_it_matters: Because Ghostscript operates invisibly behind standard web features, unpatched servers face severe remote compromise risks from benign-looking uploads.
